schema_family: claude-root-worker-seam-design (v1, v2 and v3 key sets retained where still meaningful; v4 replaces capi_predecessor with capi_status and adds witness_laws, rq1, authenticity, json_forms, p3, accounting, child_relation, custody_relation, closure, drain, requester, startup, progress_model and new_author_observations_v4)
author: Claude Code lead claude-opus-5-5 (drafting subagent, author role)

acceptance.review: An independent actual gpt-6.1-sol review of v4 is required. The author grants nothing; author checks are self-checks.

statement_basis: Static. Every statement about source was read from files or reasoned from what was read. Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured. Kernel, systemd, interpreter and Ada-visibility statements marked [unverified reasoning] name their K or RC item.

design_document.relation: v4 is this file plus the carried v3 slices of self_containment with replacements R4-1 ... R4-64 applied, plus, transitively, the v2 slices v3 binds (with R3 replacements as amended by R4) and the v1 slices v2 binds.

companions.hash_cycle: SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix D binds jackal.json and AUTHOR-NOTES.md. This file binds all three. This file's own identity is reported in the handback.

answers_review.partially_closed: V2-REQ-A ... V2-REQ-L, RQ-1 and every ruling but D-2b
answers_review.quotations: Every required change, RQ-1's rollover text, every NOT_CLOSED or PARTIALLY_CLOSED clause gap, every PARTIALLY_CLOSED ruling's owner, evidence and gap, every accepted-case risk and every C-API repair is quoted verbatim in SEAM-DESIGN.md section A.

capi6r.root_worker_integration: OPEN; no ruling on the other lane or integration order

capi_status.dependency_status: V5-RC4-GATE-EXCEPTION and V5-RC4-QUAL-CAPTURE are carried as dependencies. CAPI6R closes them at design level only, so they stay unmet for implementation, stage review, controls and proof, and G-CAPI is unmet.

self_containment.rule: Each slice's sha256 is that of the UTF-8 bytes of its v3 lines, each followed by a newline. CARRIED_VERBATIM slices are part of v4 exactly; CARRIED_WITH_LINE_REPLACEMENTS slices with the listed replacements applied.

replacements_of_v2_lines.subject: L-RB-1 split into L-RB-1P and L-RB-1C

self_containment.transitive: v2 slices C2-A3 ... C2-APC through C3-B, with R3-1 ... R3-43 as amended by R4; v1 slices through C2-APC
self_containment.verification: A read-only script checked every slice hash, every R4 quotation and target, each slice's declared replacement list, every transitive v2 and v1 slice and R3 quotation, every section-A quotation against the sealed review.json, every table's cell count and every V4 reference. All matched (observed).

field_forms: (b') one-byte sub-span of Data over a non-zero byte, for N only
(c) fresh bytes outside every rebased original span
witness_laws.W2_prime: frame-local first epochs; equals W2 with one frame (R4-58)
witness_laws.W3: Value (W.N) > 0 on every input, by L-SAT-1' (R4-20)
witness_laws.W8_prime: row universe head equals its origin frame's; last frame equals the state's; equals W8 with one frame (R4-46)
witness_laws.L_RB_1C: compaction; content, length, validity, overlap and aliasing preserved
witness_laws.L_RB_4: position independence; spec-level audit observed, body audit OPEN

residuals.R0: every unclassified input of D_raw minus D_emb
residuals.R2: no facts satisfy W5, W6 and W7 together
residuals.R3: a needed constant cannot be placed, even after compaction

witness_laws.cv_r: OPEN: the obligation that R0 is empty
witness_laws.decided_by: the unchanged original unit for every flat input

rq1.root_route_order: the serial route's guards, boundaries and exception mapping (rw/protected_operations.py:727-768), with the root launch in place of the handler; quarantine before CUSTODY_ACK by the front, after it by the worker

windows.cost: an uncertain hold and one K4 resolution

selection_chain: plan selects the custody journal and genesis
genesis binds descriptor, plan and key digests (v2 adds prior_custody)
descriptor authority_root fixes the key path
plan and descriptor fix the journal file
the verified chain fixes the head
authenticity.native_correspondence: Custody_Chain_Valid verifies integrity relative to the key it is given; it selects nothing

detected: edit, insertion or removal without the key
custody journal restored alone, through CUSTODY_REFERENCE observation events and operation-journal heads
not_detected: coordinated restore of every journal and the store
any action by a key holder

json_forms.UTF8: descriptor, startup genesis, custody genesis, owner plan, crosswalk; ensure_ascii False; optional single trailing LF
json_forms.ASCII: run-scoped config; ensure_ascii True; no LF
json_forms.number_canonical: integer lexemes canonical decimal and not -0; other lexemes equal CPython's repr of the correctly rounded binary64 value, finite only [RC-5]

p3.scope: The exe and every file-backed mapping, meaning every `/proc/<pid>/maps` line whose pathname begins with `/`, whatever its permissions.
p3.original_target_kept: rw/root_worker_process_capture.py:69-74 role checks and :75-88 before/after equality

non_claims.NC-P3-1: SOURCE-role files are read, not mapped. Their identity rests on the P2 loader lease alone.
non_claims.NC-P3-2: Anonymous executable memory (JIT, `ctypes`) is not covered.
non_claims.NC-P3-3: Mappings created and removed outside the capture interval are not covered; the capture is a point-in-time snapshot with before/after equality.
non_claims.NC-P3-4: The relation does not establish that the process runs only those images, or what their code computes.

options.C: fails AO-5 or AO-11, and AO-7
options.F: fails AO-5 and AO-11 as stated (raises an admitted outer bound)
options.G: meets AO-1 to AO-5 and AO-7; AO-6 and AO-11 only in part (handler code in the coordinator)

order: child Record_Terminal and release or charge
commit_child_checks: byte equality of the relayed measurement
the sub-helper's own native Decide or Decide_V2 = Ready
child_relation.authority_rule: drop only what RC-6 shows the original handler does not use

mutation_gates.M6: read and spool, front allowed in Stop_Intent
mutation_gates.M8: stop: original owner paths, helper kill before GO, authorized job.cancel when no owner is reachable; never settles

closure.closed_outer: helper pidfd terminal, owned launcher wait returned, MainPID = 0; no unit active-state condition
closure.never_launched_release: permitted for Never_Dispatched and Never_Launched rows only; full CLOSED_WITNESS floor for every possibly launched row
closure.reconstruction_seed: the custody intent frame's root_native event and original_native_use, the front's CLOSED events, and a fresh observation; HANDLER_TERMINAL optional

drain.read_armed: ARMED and DISARMED spool records; an open ARMED at recovery is READ_GAP_POSSIBLE (UNKNOWN)
drain.write_armed: WRITE_ARMED and W_DONE records; an open WRITE_ARMED forbids resume (STDIN_POSITION_UNKNOWN)
drain.reattachment: identity and kcmp checks, spool verification, new reader, ARMED at durable P
drain.eof: only when the last write description closes; surviving copies close at defined points; retained read copies never affect EOF

joins.Transfer_Join: FRESH, before intake, over the authenticated transfer-intent head
joins.Relay_Join: RELAY, before intake, over the same head and the relay channel

requester.user_namespace: equality when both records are present
requester.pid_namespace: correspondence to the HELD identity, never equality
requester.fallback: FRESH, then RELAY, then queued until an owner can serve; never refused

startup.initial_state: no root_state row: generation 1, FRONT_OWNED, owner Front, no subjects; head equals the genesis origin
migration: closed v1 journal: prior_custody binds path, sha256 and head; v1 journal read-only
v2 to v1: not provided; a live v2 worker's locks make v1 startup fail

capi_integration.wfx_protocol: CAPI_WFX_PROTOCOL is never extended; CR5 and CR6 run over CAPI_GATES and RW_GATES; RW gate kinds bool or case only; no RW exclusive map
capi_integration.capture: (d1)-(d4) over the union roots and simple names, every prefix of every RW with clause; no change to core/worldline.ads; no separate
capi_integration.checks: IC-1 ... IC-14 (IC-11 and IC-12 replaced by R4-43; IC-13 and IC-14 new)

added_waits: an unreachable worker's completion or an authorized cancellation

spec_nodes.completion_needs: the existing D-4a decision (not a drafting gate)

body_nodes.id: exports of B1, B2b, B2c, B2H, B3, B4, B9, B-RECV

plan.acyclic: every node's dependencies lie in an earlier wave of preparation_order

can_proceed_now: Passive drafting in the waves of preparation_order: S0, S2 and S2H; then S8 and S3; then S9 and S4; then S7, S1 and S12; then S6 and S10 (alternatives only); then S11. Each is independently reviewed. None needs the lab, root or an operator decision.

runtime_checks.owner: lead; a traced run needing root is operator work

controls.retained: every original and additive control; none retired

new_author_observations_v4.NF4-1: Root route omits quarantine after launch failures and the DISPATCH_INTENT boundary
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-2: Non-owner operations take the root route; the serial route refuses workload operations
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-3: The custody intent frame carries root_native and original_native_use
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-4: The original capture checks every file-backed mapping
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-5: initial_event has no producer or consumer in the lane
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-6: Fixed key path; head MAC covers only head and genesis
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-8: job.cancel is mutating and calls runner.cancel
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-9: Helpers pass exactly descriptors 0, 1 and 2; the helper never sees the measurement frame
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-10: Some recovery branches propagate refusals out of startup
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-12: v3's E6 recorded Launch_Intent after HELD
new_author_observations_v4.NF4-13: v3's DDL lacked an event kind for FRONT_OWNED (g+1)

open: All original obligations OB-001 ... OB-219, OPEN with no closure credited
V3-REQ-A ... V3-REQ-L, V2-REQ-A ... V2-REQ-L, RQ-1 ... RQ-5, inherited RC items other than RC-05 and RC-10, every NOT_CLOSED or PARTIALLY_CLOSED clause and ruling
CAPI6R open obligations, including ROOT_WORKER_INTEGRATION; G-CAPI unmet
Lemmas: L-BR-1, L-SAT-1', L-RB-1P, L-RB-1C, L-RB-4, W2'/W8', CJ-1, Number_Canonical, PD-1 ... PD-5, CV-B', CV-R and every carried lemma

Native units unwritten: Source_Json with Number_Canonical, Roster_Join, Root_Crosswalk, Hmac_Sha256, Custody_Chain_Valid, Root_Custody_Phase, Requester_Correspondence, Child_Event_Legal, the V2 successors, B2b and B2c successors
Premises P-A1 ... P-A4; audits AU-1, L-RB-4 bodies, RC-6, SL-0
Schemas and provisioners; plan stays plan-v1; provisioning is operator work (OP-1)

Proof and runtime: admitted strict frame, matching-source campaign (floor 251, sole boundary, zero unproved, justified and Assume), 52-action roster, lifetime controls, RQC, additive controls, hosted assurance and publication
Independent actual gpt-6.1-sol review of v4

jackal.carried_v2_results: J01-J18 keep v2's status (exact, formal false, lane rat) inside carried slices

process.writes: Write and Edit only, only in WT/designs/claude-root-worker-seam-design-v4/
process.bash: read-only; no redirection to any file; 2>&1 only into a pipe
process.deviation: one unfiltered read-only scan of the session record file named as this conversation's transcript printed two sia.ask entries that appear to be the lead's; stopped at once and not used (AUTHOR-NOTES 2.2)
process.not_run: no compiler, prover, test, WORLDLINE, COSMOGONY or root-worker code, service, systemctl, sudo, namespace, project-vault or restic; nothing under /srv
process.skills: the eight Ada skills, loaded and applied
process.storage: df -h showed 9.3G available; no storage action (project-vault outside the task's limits)

non_claims: Nothing is reviewed, accepted, proved or authorized; no approval gate is added.
Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured.
No authenticity beyond the premises P-A1 ... P-A4; no rollback detection beyond V4-C.2.
No completion, reserved-capacity, confinement, deadlock-freedom or unconditional liveness property.
Lost bytes of a crashed reader are detected, not recovered.
No C-API acceptance or integration order is decided; the other lane is neither reviewed nor corrected.
No accounting option, cap, prerequisite or policy field is selected or added.
No original accepted case gains a refusal.
